bullets.text: More than 100 aftershocks have hit Japan after a powerful earthquake killed 13 people, with officials urging continued vigilance as aftershocks could reach magnitude 7.
Two firefighters have died in Crete as wildfires threaten parts of southern Europe, with gale-force winds prompting evacuations and other parts of the continent also battling fires.
Uganda has begun emergency food handouts after 19 people died from hunger, following months of drought and crop failures that have left 1.5 million people facing malnutrition.
Poultry farmers in South Australia are concerned about the local spread of H5 bird flu, prompting alerts in coastal communities.
Advocates are calling for a new National Rental Affordability Scheme after thousands of people face significant rent increases as housing subsidies end.
Three people have died in a house fire in Wiley Park, Sydney.
The Federal Reserve maintained interest rates, despite concerns about inflation fueled by rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions, with some FOMC members advocating for higher borrowing costs.
Tech giants Meta and Qualcomm reported disappointing sales and profits, with Meta's shares tumbling due to high AI spending, while Microsoft's cloud business saw a boost from its AI investments.
Oil markets are increasingly volatile, with prices surging after geopolitical events and US oil inventories falling to 'precariously low' levels, raising concerns about global supply disruptions.
